g.text: Runs on any single host; other machines can contribute drives optionally
App host (any machine: laptop, server, or NAS)
Optional: another machine on the LAN
Single-machine is the base case: plug a drive
into the app host, register, scan, index, search.
No always-on central server is required.
Read-only is sacred: mount -o ro via ntfs-3g.
Sticker on the medium = UUID link in the catalog.
Search keeps working after the drive is removed.
Optional distributed mode: attach a drive to ANY
machine on your network; the app host imports it
over USB/IP and indexes it as if it were local.
